reason: The laws fix the old rows and their place (take and append laws). Each absent starter has exactly one new row: the count law matches the each-absent law, so the rows map one to one by id. The sub-sequence law fixes the order. The fields id, adapter and model are fixed, and the enabled flag is fixed in all three cases: enable off gives false, a locked adapter gives false, and enable on with an unlocked adapter gives the starter value.
